BYD.NAME: BYD
BYD.DESCRIPTION: BYD cars via the BYD app cloud

USERNAME.NAME: User name
USERNAME.DESCRIPTION: E-mail of the BYD app account

PIN.NAME: Control PIN
PIN.DESCRIPTION: 6-digit remote control PIN of the BYD app, needed for lock, climate and the other commands

COUNTRY.NAME: Country
COUNTRY.DESCRIPTION: Country code of the account, e.g. DE, AT, NL

POLL.NAME: Polling interval [s]
POLL.DESCRIPTION: Every poll asks the car for fresh data, keep it long to spare the 12 V battery

API_URL.NAME: API URL
API_URL.DESCRIPTION: Server of the BYD app, the default is the European one

SCAN.NAME: Find cars
SCAN.DESCRIPTION: Lists the cars of the account

CLIMATE_TEMPERATURE.NAME: Climate temperature [°C]
CLIMATE_TEMPERATURE.DESCRIPTION: Used when the climate is switched on

LOCKED.NAME: Locked
LOCKED.DESCRIPTION: Write true to lock, false to unlock

CLIMATE.NAME: Climate
CLIMATE.DESCRIPTION: Write true to start, false to stop
